reason: Close KF-P0-11 by failure-first proof against exact trusted main. Post-KF-P0-12 Release Closure Ledger reconciliation ordinary-merged as 928d68a274cf2715487d000e1dfc62fe746e7742 and exact-main source review shows backend/services/platformAdapterPorts.js constructs the default PlatformAdapterRegistryV2 singleton with authHandler and reconcileHandler only. PlatformAdapterFacade still defaults egressAuthorizer=authorizePersistedOutbox, so contract().bindings.egress can report true while the Facebook adapter has no explicit physical egressHandler and executeEgress falls through to generic sendMessageService dispatch. First implementation must remain tests-only and prove this exact default Facebook physical-egress binding seam through a dedicated Stage-routed WP0 contract. Production remains forbidden until a fresh causal RED with unknownBlockers=0 is recorded and a separate same-root production amendment ordinary-merges.
